description: Search Pansofica records of people and organizations and pxl8.io fighter records by name. Each result carries an id in the form the fetch tool reads, and its url. Answers { results: [{ id, title, url }] } as one JSON document: at most 5 person or organization records first, then at most 5 fighter records; a query under 3 characters answers an empty list. A notice member says when one of the two sources could not be searched. This is a lookup, not a list. Each result carries its `url` and the `citeAs` attribution line in `metadata`; a disputed fact remains in the answer, marked with the word Disputed. This is the lookup tier that needs no key (rate-limited per client and in total); keyed partner access with higher limits exists.

query.description: A person's, an organization's or a fighter's name, or the first characters of it (at most 200 characters)

name: search
title: Search records
